This '''castle''', a rustic building in the [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]] outback, was where [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] chose to serve his [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] sentence around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Loathsom was eventually rescued from his imprisonment by Separatist operatives.
